description: Min-p's tile-form kernel (vLLM tilelang-ports 08c1383c3) against Triton: each run (16-byte vectors or scalars), threads a block and tile width first compared with Triton bit for bit (threshold seeds 48291-48298 at 96 rows, non-finite rows), then timed in paired CUDA graphs at 1, 16 and 96 rows of 129280 columns, on image -next-4 with the ports' package files mounted over it.
